Title: Ptolemy's geocentric model
Body-Text: Working in Alexandria, Claudius Ptolemy organized observations into a mathematical, Earth-centered account of the heavens. In the Almagest, he described the motions of the Sun, Moon, planets, and fixed stars using combinations of circles, including epicycles. His model shaped astronomy for more than a millennium.
